items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: I didn’t know Branford then so I took his word for it, and he did, he didn’t have, I remember he didn’t have the neck strap, so he was like playing with no neck strap.

ctx.x: What was his full name again?

Tujai FiFi Te Tai Tae. So it was a little Yorkie dog. Crazy. A very crazy Yorkie dog. He would, we had loft beds that were about up to the top of the curtain there. And if you were chopping carrots, that was his favorite thing to eat, raw carrots, he’d jump right off the loft. This little tiny dog. I mean a very crazy dog. And the little call at the beginning of the recording, that works for ninety percent of any Yorkies. If you go down the street in New York and see a Yorkie and you want it to turn around and…
Oh it was Branford? Well you asked him to do a couple different things then. He was on alto on that thing, right? “And you have to bark—”
